title: Mysterious Objects Spotted Over Mechanicville, Corinth and Beyond
excerpt: A massive silent aircraft, glowing orbs and mysterious triangular lights. What are New Yorkers seeing?
content:
The UFO Sightings Reported Across New York in October

From mysterious glowing orbs to massive, silent aircraft, October was an interesting month for UFO sightings across New York State.

According to reports submitted to the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC), several New Yorkers witnessed unusual activity in the skies last month, including two sightings practically in our own backyard.

What these people saw is certainly up for debate, but some of their descriptions are fascinating, and as a UFO/UAP enthusiast, I check NUFORC regularly to see what Upstate New Yorkers may have witnessed.

Here are five of the more intriguing UFO sightings reported across New York in October 2026.

These are eyewitness accounts submitted to NUFORC, not independently verified encounters or evidence of extraterrestrial activity.

October 4 – Mechanicville, NY

Approximately 20 miles north of Albany

A witness reported seeing spinning lights in a triangular formation that eventually transformed into three horizontal bars. One light appeared to move playfully around another. The entire encounter lasted approximately nine seconds, and the objects reportedly made no sound.

October 10 – Phoenix, NY

Approximately 165 miles northwest of Albany

A witness who identified themselves as working in law enforcement reported seeing a bright orange orb that separated into four individual orbs. The objects formed a line and faded individually as they traveled north. The sighting lasted approximately 10 seconds.

October 14 – Corinth, NY

Approximately 50 miles north of Albany

At approximately 11 p.m., a witness reported seeing two mysterious orbs, one yellow and one blue, flying approximately 500 feet above the ground. The witness claimed the objects emitted beams of light before traveling west. The encounter lasted approximately 25 seconds.

October 18 – Pleasant Valley, NY

Approximately 70 miles south of Albany

At around 7 p.m., a witness reported seeing a black, triangular object with lights. The encounter lasted approximately four minutes. NUFORC listed conventional aircraft as a probable explanation.

October 19 – Greenlawn, NY

Approximately 175 miles south of Albany

Perhaps the most detailed report came from Long Island, where a witness described a silent, V-shaped craft estimated to be 60 to 70 feet wide.

The witness reported seeing 15 to 20 illuminated ports underneath the object, which was traveling north toward Connecticut at an estimated 60 to 80 mph, about 160 to 180 feet above the ground.  Crazy!

What makes this sighting particularly interesting is that the witness previously worked as a design engineer for Grumman Aerospace and claimed the mysterious craft resembled nothing they had ever seen before.

It makes you wonder: What exactly are these people seeing?
